action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Dileep Kumar Jallepalli discovered that apng2gif incorrectly handled
loading APNG files, leading to an integer overflow and a heap-based buffer
over-read. If a user or automated system were tricked into converting a
specially crafted APNG file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to
obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service. (CVE-2017-6960)

Dileep Kumar Jallepalli discovered that apng2gif did not limit the size of
memory allocations when reading APNG chunks. If a user or automated  system
were tricked into converting a specially crafted APNG file, an  attacker
could possibly use this issue to cause apng2gif to crash, resulting  in a
denial of service. (CVE-2017-6961)

Dileep Kumar Jallepalli discovered that apng2gif incorrectly handled
certain  chunk sizes, leading to an integer overflow and a heap-based
buffer overflow.  If a user or automated system were tricked into
converting a specially crafted  APNG file, an attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause apng2gif to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or
possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-6962)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in apng2gif.
